title: Select service — overrides table populates
steps: Select any service with existing price overrides
expected: Table renders rows with Branch, Customer Type, Price (RM formatted), Effective From, Effective Until columns. Branch column shows node name (not raw UUID). Price formatted as 'RM X.XX'.

title: No service selected — empty state shown
expected: Dashed empty-state box with text 'Select a service above to view its price overrides.' is visible. Add Override button is disabled.

title: Service selected with no overrides — empty state shown
steps: Select a service that has zero price overrides
expected: Dashed empty-state box with text 'No price overrides configured for this service.' is visible. Add Override button is enabled.

title: Add org-wide, all-customer-type override — happy path
expected: Toast 'Price override saved.' appears. Dialog closes. Table refreshes and shows a new row with Branch='Org-wide / All branches', Customer Type='All', Price='RM 150.00', Effective Until='Open-ended'.

title: Add branch-scoped, member-only override with date range
steps: Select a specific branch from Branch dropdown
Set Effective Until to 30 days from now
expected: Toast 'Price override saved.' appears. Override row shows the branch name, 'Member', 'RM 99.00', and both dates formatted in en-MY locale.

title: Expire an override — confirmation flow
steps: Select a service with at least one override
Verify confirmation dialog opens with correct text
expected: Toast 'Price override expired.' appears. Dialog closes. The expired row disappears from the table (effectiveUntil is set to now, so it fails the >now filter).

title: Delete an override — confirmation flow
steps: Select a service with at least one override
expected: Toast 'Price override deleted.' appears. Dialog closes. Row is permanently removed from table.

title: Cancel expire confirmation — no mutation
expected: Dialog closes. Row remains in table. No toast. No API call.

title: Cancel delete confirmation — no mutation
expected: Dialog closes. Row remains in table. No toast. No API call.

title: Cancel add override dialog — form resets
steps: Change price to '200', change branch to something specific
expected: Dialog closes. Re-opening 'Add Override' shows fresh form with defaults: Org-wide branch, All customer type, empty price, effectiveFrom = now, effectiveUntil blank.

title: Submit with no service selected — client guard fires
steps: Open add override dialog (if service is pre-filled, clear it — only possible via direct prop change or if defaultServiceId is undefined)
Attempt to submit with empty service select
expected: Toast 'Please select a service.' shown. No API call. Dialog stays open.

title: Submit with empty price — HTML required fires (or rmToCents NaN path)
steps: Open add override dialog, select a service
expected: Browser native 'required' validation fires first. If bypassed, rmToCents('') throws NaN path → toast 'Enter a valid price in RM.'

title: Submit with negative price — client guard fires
steps: Open add override dialog, select a service
expected: rmToCents throws 'Invalid amount' → toast 'Enter a valid price in RM.' No API call.

title: Submit with price zero — allowed at all layers
steps: Open add override dialog, select a service
expected: API accepts (server: z.number().int().min(0) allows 0). Override saved with RM 0.00. Table shows 'RM 0.00'. No error.

title: Submit with effectiveUntil before effectiveFrom — no validation, silent bad row
steps: Open add override dialog, select a service
Set Effective Until to 2026-01-01 00:00 (earlier than From)
expected: CURRENT BEHAVIOR: Save succeeds. Toast 'Price override saved.' appears. Row does NOT appear in the table (fails effectiveFrom <= now filter). No error is shown to user — this is a silent usability failure. DESIRED: validation error before submit.

title: Add future-dated override — disappears from list immediately
steps: Open add override dialog, select a service
expected: CURRENT BEHAVIOR: Save succeeds (toast success). Table shows 'No price overrides configured' because listServicePriceOverrides filters effectiveFrom <= now. The just-created row is invisible. No user feedback explains this. DESIRED: future-dated overrides should appear in the list (they are valid configurations).

title: Add duplicate (same service/branch/customerType/overlap) — silent insert, no overlap error
steps: Add override: service A, org-wide, all, RM 100, open-ended
Add override again: same service A, org-wide, all, RM 200, open-ended
expected: CURRENT BEHAVIOR: Both rows inserted. Table shows both. Pricing resolution uses tie-breaking (most recent effectiveFrom wins). No error or warning about overlap. DESIRED: server should reject or warn about overlapping overrides for the same (service, branch, customerType) combination.

title: Add override with past effectiveFrom — row immediately active
expected: Save succeeds. Row appears in table immediately (effectiveFrom <= now filter passes). No validation error for past dates. Consider whether this is intended.

title: Expire an already-expired override — server allows it
steps: Directly create a price override row with effectiveUntil in the past (via API or DB seed)
Attempt to expire it via the UI (it won't appear in the table, so this requires a direct API call)
expected: Server side: expireServicePrice updates effectiveUntil to now even if already past. No error. UI: this state is unreachable via normal UI flow because expired rows are filtered out.

title: Network error on setBranchPrice — error toast with server message
steps: Intercept/mock the setBranchPrice call to throw an Error('Server unavailable')
expected: Toast shows 'Server unavailable' (server error message forwarded). Dialog stays open. isSaving resets to false.

title: Network error on expireBranchPrice — generic error toast
expected: Toast shows generic 'Failed to expire price override.' Server error detail is NOT forwarded. Dialog remains open. isExpiring resets.

title: Network error on deleteBranchPrice — generic error toast
expected: Toast shows generic 'Failed to delete price override.' Server error detail NOT forwarded. isDeleting resets.

title: listPriceOverrides API error — misleading empty state
steps: Mock the listPriceOverrides call to fail (network error / 500)
expected: CURRENT BEHAVIOR: Query returns undefined, overrides defaults to [], renders 'No price overrides configured' empty state — identical to genuinely empty. No error message. DESIRED: error state should be surfaced separately.

title: Permission: user without service_management:update cannot add override
steps: Log in as a user with service_management:read but NOT service_management:update
expected: Server returns FORBIDDEN. Client shows toast with error (server message forwarded). Override is not created.

title: Permission: user without service_management:delete cannot delete override
steps: Log in as user with service_management:update but NOT service_management:delete
Click 'Delete' on a row and confirm
expected: Server returns FORBIDDEN. Toast 'Failed to delete price override.' shown (generic — server detail NOT forwarded for delete).

title: Staff member sets override for branch outside their scope
steps: Log in as staff member scoped to Branch A
Click 'Add Override', select Branch B (a sibling branch not in scope)
expected: Server calls guardInputBranchForContext → FORBIDDEN. Client toast shows server error message. Override not saved.

title: No organization context — page shows org-selection message
steps: Load page while userContext.currentOrganizationId is null
expected: Full-page centered message 'Select an organization to manage pricing.' No table, no dropdown.
selectorHints: getByText(/select an organization to manage pricing/i)

title: Overrides loading state — spinner text visible
steps: Observe the brief loading state before data arrives
expected: Text 'Loading...' is visible while overridesLoading is true.

title: Branch name resolution — unknown branchId falls back to raw UUID
steps: Create a price override for a branch that has since been deleted or is not in the hierarchy query
expected: Branch column shows raw UUID string (branchMap.get returns undefined, fallback is row.branchId). Not a crash, but unreadable UX.

title: Open-ended override displays 'Open-ended' in Effective Until column
steps: Add override with blank Effective Until
expected: 'Open-ended' text appears in Effective Until column for that row.

title: Services list empty — select dropdown is empty
steps: Log in to an org with no services configured
expected: Service dropdown renders empty. 'Select a service to view overrides...' placeholder shown. Add Override disabled.

title: Route guard redirects unauthenticated user
expected: Redirect to /login (handled by _authenticated parent route or requirePermission detecting missing session).

title: Route guard redirects user without service_management:read
steps: Log in as user without service_management:read permission
expected: Redirect to /dashboard?unauthorized=true (requirePermission beforeLoad fires).

title: Walk-in customer type override displays 'Walk-in' label in table
expected: Customer Type column shows 'Walk-in' (not 'walk_in' raw value).

title: Changing selected service clears previous service's overrides
steps: Select Service A — table shows Service A overrides
expected: Table immediately shows loading state then Service B overrides (different queryKey). Service A overrides are NOT shown.
